note:
Re-measured on the rebase of this branch onto origin/19.0-marin.

This branch banked 561 -> 483 by appending, per module, exactly the blocks the gate
reported unresolved -- copied out of a fresh export so their `#.`/`#:` references are the
exporter's own, into files otherwise left byte-for-byte alone. That repair survives the
rebase, but two of its seven modules were renamed underneath it by origin: base_automation
-> automation and base_vat -> account_vat. The appended blocks moved with them, with the
module line, the `#: code:` paths, one xmlid reference and one msgid retargeted --
base_automation.py -> automation_rule.py, and the cron string origin reworded
(`automation.ir_cron_data_automation_check`, "update the 'automation' module"), since
`_()` looks up by exact source text and a stale msgid resolves to nothing. Both modules
measure 0 unresolved after the move.

499 is what the merged tree reports; the gap to 483 is origin's own drift, not this
branch's. Re-export properly -- from a database whose install set is at least the one a
catalogue was built from -- before trusting a bulk rewrite of any of these files.
